Simple harmonic motion (SHM) is a special case of periodic motion which results when the magnitude of the restoring force exerted on an object is proportional to that object’s displacement from its equilibrium position. SHM is described by sinusoidal position, velocity, and acceleration functions. A spring-mass oscillator is one type of system that undergoes SHM. The period of a spring-mass oscillator is related to its mass and spring constant.
